title: 第17章 青玄宗圣女凌雪瑶第18章 我特么怎会有你这个混账玩意
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
吴长风的表情和情绪达到完美状态，结合他仰天悲痛的语气，这句话一出，在场不少弟子均是脸色微变！
也确实如此，青玄宗每年都有新弟子拜入宗门，若是此事传出，一个杂役弟子，以如此卑鄙的手段取得一品炼丹师的认证，那还有谁会真心去学习炼丹，均会私自效仿，届时青玄宗宝库逐渐被掏空，谁还会拜入青玄宗，青玄宗也逐渐会走向衰弱。
广场上的所有人听到何念慈和吴长风的话，望向墨尘居和陆成的眼神也是极其怪异。
陆成现在就算炼出极品夺灵丹又如何？
会有人信他是靠自己本事炼出来的吗？
场面再度变得剑拔弩张起来！
所有人纷纷看向陆成，目光不善，杀意骤升。
吴长风一顶事关青玄宗未来危机的大帽子扣了过来，让墨尘居脸色骤变。
陆成也是目光一愣，若不是吴长风口中说的是他，他差点忍不住拍手叫好了，这吴长风竟也是一个口才大师，三言两句便把此事升级到了一个更高的程度，竟扯到了青玄宗几百年后的结局，他都有点佩服了！
墨尘居语气陡然一冷，道：“吴长老……你这话有点严重了吧！！”
墨尘居也没想到会成为这副局面，现在哪怕陆成炼出极品夺灵丹，也根本不会摆脱死局，因为之前王飞宇的一番言论让所有人彻底对陆成失去了信任，是陆成通过阴谋诡计骗了他，自己和陆成才来认证这一品炼丹师。
想到此，他目光看向陆成，道：“陆成，用你的控火诀，现场演练一下，让大家看看！”
陆成点了点头，正准备施展控火诀。
这时，王飞宇眉头一皱，打算浇一把火，再次跳了出来，低吼道：“陆成，你的那套邪术，如实招来，你是以何等手段欺骗过墨大师的，啊？！”
说着，他嘴角露出一丝邪笑，陡然拔出长剑，寒声道：“你若如实招来，念在你是墨大师的弟子，我等给你留个全尸！”
吴长风也对墨尘居冷笑道：“装神弄鬼，我看就没有必要用控火诀了，一个骗子而已，就不要再蛊惑大家了！！”
何念慈嗤笑一声，目光看向王飞宇，道：“这小子说得不错。”说着，他目光看向陆成，冷笑道：“还不快快招来！”
陆成突然愣了，这些人，竟然连一丝给他施展控火诀的机会都不给么？
他目光扫过所有人，脸色平静，但这副平静的面孔在所有人看来就是在装，不少人看向陆成的目光再次充满了鄙夷。
这小子从始至终都露出一股目中无人的表情，此刻却依旧面不改色，看得不少人都暗暗咬牙，他们见过装逼的，没见过这么装逼的。

只不过陆成这副模样在他们看来，就是临死前的装罢了！
陆成向前一步，开口道：“诸位长老、师兄……”
“还想狡辩，找死！！”王飞宇再次出声打断陆成，他左右顾盼，见此刻众人想杀陆成的情绪已达到巅峰，他已不想再给他说话的机会，直接怒喝一声，他双手紧握长剑，脚尖一踏，猛然掠出，向陆成一剑刺来！
王飞宇突然暴起，惊呆了众人，看见有人主动带头，而且这人还是内门长老王厉的孙子，他们也瞬间开始拔剑！
丹峰广场上赫然响起“次次次”的拔剑声，一道道寒光不断闪出。
“放肆！你敢！！”墨尘居也没想到王飞宇突然持剑冲向陆成，脸色一沉，怒吼一声，身形瞬间消失在原地。
王飞宇眨眼间便到达陆成面前，却没想到墨尘居突然出现，紧跟着他便感觉面前突然涌来一股恐怖的灵气，他瞬间被拍飞了！
王飞宇如断线风筝般向人群中砸去，他是炼气十层，怎可能是筑基大圆满墨尘居的对手，那一掌尽管墨尘居只用了五分力，但依旧不是王飞宇可以抵抗的。
王飞宇砰的一声重重砸在地上，由于是脸先着地，鼻梁骨瞬间断了，牙也崩断了几颗，鲜血喷涌而出，然后随着惯性在地面上滚了十几圈，最后撞到一颗巨石上才停了下来。
陆成目光一凝，眸内闪过滔天杀意！
这王飞宇三番两次挑衅他，并在他开口解释时突然打断他，大家此刻本对他不满，这时王飞宇出手，这行为，分明就是挑头，挑起众人心中的杀意，让众人对他出手！
他心中彻底怒了，他的双手死死紧握，他此刻非常想杀了王飞宇。
这时，王飞宇踉跄着爬起，表情扭曲地捂着鼻子，抬手颤抖地指着墨尘居，说话露风，一字一字冷声道：“墨尘居，你敢拦我！好！很好！！”
“诸位同门师兄还不出手，立刻杀了陆成这个废物！”
王飞宇此话一出，广场上方才拔剑的众人眼中纷纷战意滔天，他们之中不少人背后亦有内门长老当靠山，自然不惧墨尘居，纷纷向前一步，杀意滔天！
他们的目标全部对准了陆成！
这时，一名紫袍弟子面带寒光，目光从陆成身上挪到墨尘居身上，道：“我等只诛杀陆成，还望墨长老莫要多管闲事！！”
“墨大师，还请……”
content_en:
Wu Changfeng's expression and emotion were in perfect condition. Combined with his sad tone, as soon as these words came out, the expressions of many disciples present changed slightly!
It is true that Qingxuan Sect has new disciples joining the sect every year. If this news comes out that a handyman disciple has obtained the certification of a first-grade alchemist in such despicable means, then who else will sincerely learn alchemy and will follow suit privately. By then, the Qingxuan Sect's treasure house will be gradually emptied, who will worship Qingxuan Sect, and Qingxuan Sect will gradually weaken.
When everyone in the square heard what He Nianci and Wu Changfeng said, they looked at Mo Chenju and Lu Cheng with extremely strange looks.
So what if Lu Cheng refines the best spiritual elixir now?
Will anyone believe that he relied on his own ability to refine it?
The scene became tense again!
Everyone looked at Lu Cheng with evil eyes and murderous intent.
Wu Changfeng slapped him with a big label related to the future crisis of Qingxuan Sect, which made Mo Chenju's expression suddenly change.
Lu Cheng was also stunned. If Wu Changfeng hadn't been talking about him, he almost couldn't help but clap his hands and applaud. Wu Changfeng was actually a master of eloquence. He escalated the matter to a higher level in just a few words, and actually involved the outcome of Qingxuan Sect hundreds of years later. He was a little impressed!
Mo Chenju's tone suddenly turned cold and he said: "Elder Wu...what you said is a bit serious!!"
Mo Chenju did not expect to be in this situation. Now even if Lu Cheng refines the best spiritual elixir, he will not be able to get out of the deadlock at all, because Wang Feiyu's previous remarks made everyone completely lose trust in Lu Cheng. It was Lu Cheng who deceived him through conspiracy and tricks, and he and Lu Cheng came to certify this first-class alchemist.
Thinking of this, he looked at Lu Cheng and said, "Lu Cheng, use your fire control technique and practice it on the spot for everyone to see!"
Lu Cheng nodded and was about to use the Fire Control Technique.
At this time, Wang Feiyu frowned, intending to add fuel to the fire, and jumped out again, roaring: "Lu Cheng, your evil spells are true. How did you deceive Master Mo, ah?!"
As he spoke, a wicked smile appeared at the corner of his mouth, and he suddenly pulled out his long sword and said in a cold voice: "If you call me truthfully, since you are Master Mo's disciple, I will leave you a complete corpse!"
Wu Changfeng also sneered at Mo Chenju and said: "I think there is no need to use the Fire Control Technique if you are pretending to be a god or a ghost. I am just a liar, so stop confusing everyone!!"
He Nianci sneered, looked at Wang Feiyu, and said, "This guy is right." After saying that, he looked at Lu Cheng and sneered, "Why don't you hurry up and recruit us!"
Lu Cheng was suddenly stunned. Did these people not even give him a chance to use the Fire Control Technique?
He glanced at everyone, his face calm, but this calm face seemed to everyone to be pretending, and many people looked at Lu Cheng with eyes full of contempt again.
This kid showed a arrogant expression from beginning to end, but at this moment, his expression remained unchanged, which made many people grit their teeth secretly. They had seen pretentious people, but never seen such pretentious ones.
It's just that in their opinion, Lu Cheng's appearance was just a pretense before his death!
Lu Cheng took a step forward and said, "Elders and senior brothers..."
"You still want to quibble and seek death!!" Wang Feiyu interrupted Lu Cheng again. He looked around and saw that everyone's desire to kill Lu Cheng had reached its peak at this moment. He no longer wanted to give him a chance to speak, so he shouted angrily. He clenched the long sword with both hands, stepped on his toes, suddenly rushed out, and stabbed Lu Cheng!
Wang Feiyu suddenly burst out and shocked everyone. Seeing someone taking the initiative, and this person was the grandson of Wang Li, the elder of the inner sect, they immediately started to draw their swords!
The sound of drawing swords could be heard loudly in Danfeng Square, and streaks of cold light kept flashing out.
"How dare you! How dare you!!" Mo Chenju didn't expect that Wang Feiyu suddenly rushed towards Lu Cheng with a sword, his face darkened, and he roared angrily., the figure instantly disappeared in place.
Wang Feiyu arrived in front of Lu Cheng in the blink of an eye, but he did not expect that Mo Chenju suddenly appeared. Immediately afterwards, he felt a sudden surge of terrifying spiritual energy in front of him, and he was instantly knocked away!
Wang Feiyu smashed into the crowd like a kite with a broken string. He was at the tenth level of Qi Refining, so how could he be Mo Chenju's opponent in the Foundation Establishment Dzogchen. Even though Mo Chenju only used five points of force in that palm, it was still not something Wang Feiyu could resist.
Wang Feiyu hit the ground with a loud bang. Because he landed face first, his nose was broken instantly and several teeth were broken. Blood spurted out. Then he rolled on the ground with inertia for more than ten times, and finally stopped after hitting a boulder.
Lu Cheng's eyes narrowed, and murderous intent flashed in his eyes!
This Wang Feiyu repeatedly provoked him and suddenly interrupted him when he was opening his mouth to explain. Everyone was dissatisfied with him at this moment, and then Wang Feiyu took action. This behavior was clearly a provocation, provoking the murderous intention in everyone's hearts, and making everyone take action against him!
He was completely angry and clenched his hands tightly. He wanted to kill Wang Feiyu very much at this moment.
At this time, Wang Feiyu staggered up, covering his nose with a distorted expression, raised his hand and pointed at Mo Chenju tremblingly, and said in a cold voice, word by word: "Mo Chenju, you dare to stop me! Okay! Very good!!"
"If all my fellow disciples don't take action, kill this loser Lu Cheng immediately!"
As soon as Wang Feiyu said these words, the eyes of everyone who had just drawn their swords in the square were full of fighting intent. Many of them also had inner sect elders as their backers. Naturally, they were not afraid of Mo Chenju and stepped forward one after another with overwhelming killing intent!
Their targets were all aimed at Lu Cheng!
At this time, a purple-robed disciple had a cold look on his face, his eyes moved from Lu Cheng to Mo Chenju, and said: "We are only going to kill Lu Cheng, and I hope Elder Mo will stop meddling in other people's business!!"
"Master Mo, please..."
